objective.name: projection_request
objective.description: Defines a temporary request to rebuild the continuity projection using a deterministic projection definition before the next pilot inference.

functional._projection_note: Required. Deterministic projection definition to apply.
functional._mode_note: Optional. merge supplements the pilot default projection; replace temporarily substitutes it. Defaults to merge.
functional._budget_note: Optional. Maximum budget granted to the resulting continuity projection for this request.
